facts.text: Jolene shared a memory of finding her snake after it had escaped, which made her feel relieved and grateful.

evidence.quote: I have lots of great memories, like our little 'snake adventure'. She got out and I spent hours searching, so relieved when I finally found her snuggling under the bed.
Seeing her snuggled under the bed made me feel so much love and gratitude. It made me realize how important she is to me.
